description: Beta builds of AnymeX+ (AnymeX with Stremio built in). Installs next to the normal app as AnymeX+ β, with its own sign-ins and library. New fixes land here first.

apps.name: AnymeX+ β
apps.subtitle: AnymeX+ beta builds
apps.localizedDescription: Beta builds of AnymeX+ (AnymeX with Stremio built in). Installs next to the normal app as AnymeX+ β, with its own sign-ins and library. New fixes land here first.
apps.versionDescription:
Beta v1.1.3-beta+3

- Fix the wrong episode playing, and add "Mark as not watched"
  - Some extensions list episodes oldest first; the list then came out backwards (6, 5, 4…) and the numbers and titles landed on the wrong episodes, so the card for episode 2 played episode 5. Such lists are now put the right way round, so cards, titles and what plays match.
  - Long-press on a watched episode has "Mark as not watched": the eye mark and resume point go, and your list progress steps back to before it. It also works without a tracker signed in.
